summary: Realloys Inc. filed Form 8-K to disclose a Rare Earth Product Offtake Agreement with Critical Metals Corp for eudialyte-derived rare earth concentrate from the Tanbreez project in Greenland. The 15-year agreement commits Realloys to purchase 15% of monthly Phase 1 production (up to 1/12 of 15% of 15,000 metric tons). Pricing is based on a formula tied to payable elements (NdPr, Dy, Tb, Y). No upfront payment, premium, or board recommendation is stated; no financial advisors named. The agreement has a five-year conditional start period and no break fee. This is a routine supply contract, not a special situation.
